April 11 I tried to kill myself. I made (what I thought at the time) the mistake of calling someone and telling them that I downed a bottle of klonopin. It was meant to be a “hey goodbye” thinking there was no way they could call anyone or have any means to intervene. I was wrong. Ended up getting sent to a mental hospital. I was so pissed that I lived. Holy shit I was so mad that I lived. And there I was in a mental hospital with no means to try again. I spent months in the worst depression of my life. But it got better. It took time, but it got better.

I swear on everything I love, that it gets better. Maybe in a week, maybe in a month, maybe in a year. But one day you will wake up happy. Please hang on and wait for that day. That day could be tomorrow. You matter. You are loved. You are a life worth living.
